description: Flag a recipe, review, photo or a cook's profile for Befana's moderators: spam, offensive, unsafe as written, copied without permission, not a recipe, or something else. Use only when the cook asks ("report this review", "this recipe is dangerous"), in their words. Moderators review every report; nothing is hidden automatically.

id.description: The recipe slug, the review id, the photo URL, or the cook's handle for a profile

note.description: What's wrong, in the cook's words

reason.description: spam: Spam or advertising; offensive: Offensive or hateful; unsafe: Unsafe to cook or eat as written; copyright: Copied without permission; not_recipe: Not a real recipe; other: Something else

name: report_content

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

duplicate.description: True when this cook already had an open report on the item: nothing new was stored

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Befana suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Befana suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

target.description: What the report points at, as the reporter sees it

title: Report a recipe, review, photo or profile
